scope_semantics: Each file carries scope=subject or scope=dataset. scope=subject files have a subject field and belong to that subject alone. scope=dataset files belong to no single subject -- a montage, a README, band or interval definitions -- and are needed whichever subject is fetched. The how field records which rule decided: data_path (moabb returned it for exactly one subject), returned_for_several_subjects, sibling_of_subject_file (a companion such as an EEGLAB .fdt, inherited from a directory whose attributed files all share one subject), or not_returned_by_data_path.
